newsitem.title: USA: 3M shares up on earnings, strong market.
newsitem.headline: 3M shares up on earnings, strong market.

text.p: Shares in Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co rose 3-1/2 to 86-3/4 Tuesday on the back of a solid first-quarter report and a blue-chip rally that lifted the Dow Jones industrial average more than 102 points in early afternoon trading.
"Good earnings and a strong market. You can't beat that," said Hilliard Lyons industry analyst Stephen O'Neil.
St. Paul, Minn.-based 3M reported that it earned $410 million on sales of $3.71 billion on the quarter, up from year-ago earnings of $362 million on sales of $3.47 billion.
"It was a solid quarter, but it was against reasonably easy comparisons," said Merrill Lynch analyst Robert Curran.
First-quarter earnings of $0.99 per share bested the First Call consensus of Wall Street analysts' forecasts by a penny -- good but likely not good enough to explain the share rally.
"I think it's certainly more than just the earnings," Curran said.
As a widely traded, Dow 30 stock, 3M often moves with broad market swings, analysts said.
